intent: Add an optional status query-parameter filter to GET /tasks so callers can request only tasks in one TaskState (Open, InProgress, Done). Matching is case-insensitive; GET /tasks with no status parameter keeps returning all tasks unchanged; an unrecognised status value returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with no task list. Query-shaping convenience only: no authentication, no persistence-model change, no change to the store's public shape - the filter lives at the endpoint/query boundary.
